name: Lipase-driven chylomicron triglyceride and phospholipid catabolism
rationale: All members concern LPL/LIPC lipase hydrolysis of triglyceride and phospholipid in chylomicron remodeling and clearance, whereas confusables center on VLDL/LDL assembly, clearance and LXR-driven lipogenesis.

core: Post-transcriptional silencing by miRNAs and lncRNAs
name: Noncoding RNA control of mRNA translation and stability
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC, miRNA/lncRNA/ceRNA-mediated silencing of specific transcripts and RNA-binding-protein stabilization of mRNA, distinguishing it from confusables focused on ARE-binding decay factors, siRNA, decapping or 3'-end processing.

qualifier: lung, trachea, prostate and salivary/lacrimal glands
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, prostate and salivary organogenesis
rationale: Members describe mesenchyme-epithelium interactions driving branching, bud and epithelial differentiation in lung, trachea, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands, genitalia and palate, unlike confusables focused on mammary, gonadal and pancreatic development.

core: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and cell density sensing
qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and TGF-beta receptor-SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine Hippo pathway regulation, contact-density sensing and YAP/TAZ transcription with cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3, distinguishing it from confusables on RUNX3 targets, SMAD4/TCF7L2 mutants, TFAP2 or anoikis.

core: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
name: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and IRF3-driven type I interferon
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA sensing, ZBP1 and cytosolic DNA sensing leading to IRF3-mediated type I IFN and IP-10 induction, whereas confusables emphasize IRF7/TLR, negative regulators, OAS effectors or interferon-alpha responses.

core: IL-17 and IL-1 family cytokine receptor signaling
name: IL-17 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 receptor signaling
rationale: All members are receptor signaling by IL-17 or the IL-1 family cytokines IL-33, IL-36 and IL-38, while confusables center on IL-17 production and Th17 commitment, C-type lectin, IL-18 or IL-23 signaling.

qualifier: smooth muscle phenotypic switching and endothelial shear stress response
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and endothelial shear response
rationale: Members cover vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, differentiation and phenotypic switching with SRF-driven cytoskeletal programs and endothelial responses to laminar/oscillatory shear, unlike confusables centered on cardiac muscle growth or VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis.

name: Spermiogenic sperm flagellum assembly and motility
rationale: Members concern building the sperm axoneme, central apparatus, mitochondrial sheath and manchette plus regulation of flagellar motility within the Sertoli-supported testis, whereas confusables cover germ-cell specification, tubulin modification, dynein-arm assembly of motile cilia or primary-cilium trafficking.

core: Nuclear pore transport and nuclear envelope dynamics
name: Nuclear pore transport, mitotic envelope remodeling and SUMOylation
rationale: Members span nuclear pore complex assembly and NLS/Ran-dependent import-export, mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation, and the SUMO conjugation cascade on nuclear substrates, distinguishing it from confusables on ESCRT-III envelope sealing or mRNA export.

qualifier: MHC expression and antigen presentation to T cells
name: Interferon-gamma-driven MHC expression and T cell antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover the IFN-gamma response with regulation of MHC class I and II biosynthesis, T cell antigen presentation and CD8 T cell proliferation, whereas confusables emphasize IFNG receptor signaling itself or Th1 differentiation and dendritic cell cytokine production.

name: CaMK-CREB and CaMKK-AMPK postsynapse-to-nucleus signaling in memory
rationale: Members describe NMDA-receptor-driven CaMKII/CaMKIV phosphorylation of CREB, CaMKK-AMPK activation and NPAS4 induction underlying LTP and memory, distinguishing it from confusables on cAMP/PKA-CREB, NMDA receptor gating or MECP2.

core: Tight junction regulation of paracellular barrier
name: Tight junction control of paracellular barrier permeability
rationale: Members concern tight junction assembly, disassembly and protein localization governing paracellular transport and vascular, intestinal and blood-brain barrier permeability, unlike confusables on calcium-dependent adherens junctions, polarity or mechanosensing.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis and thyroid hormone activation
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium conversion and excretion, selenocysteine synthesis via UGA readthrough, and regulation of thyroid hormone generation, transport and activity (selenoprotein deiodinase-dependent), distinguishing it from confusables on thyroid hormone receptor signaling, ROS detoxification or iodide/sulfonation.

core: Cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
name: Cullin neddylation-COP9 deneddylation cycle and RHOBTB GTPases
rationale: Members concern NEDD8 conjugation and COP9 signalosome removal regulating cullin-RING ligases (e.g., CUL1-mediated NFE2L2 degradation) and the RHOBTB GTPases that act as CUL3 adaptors, unlike confusables on generic ubiquitination, proteasomal destabilization or PD-L1 degradation.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members cover ryanodine-receptor calcium release, SERCA reuptake, sodium/calcium exchange, T-tubules and their control of cardiac contraction, relaxation and rhythm, distinguishing it from confusables on store-operated calcium entry, chemical control of heart rate or fiber-type transition.

name: Mitochondrial fission-fusion balance and depolarization-induced mitophagy
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial fission, fusion and fragmentation together with depolarization-triggered PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, whereas confusables concern mitochondrial protein localization, membrane potential or receptor-mediated mitophagy.

qualifier: ROCK, PAK and citron kinase effector activation
name: Rho-family GTPase cycles and ROCK/PAK/citron effector activation
rationale: Members are the RHO, RAC, CDC42 and RND GTPase cycles with activation of their effectors (formins, WASP/WAVE, IQGAP, and the kinases ROCK, PAK and citron), distinguishing it from confusables on downstream actin filament operations, G12/13-Sema4D Rho activation or filopodia.

qualifier: G beta-gamma to Rac, PI3K-gamma and PLC-beta
name: Leukocyte G beta-gamma signaling to Rac, PI3K-gamma and PLC-beta
rationale: Members link chemoattractant and S1P receptor G beta-gamma signaling through PI3K-gamma, PLC-beta and RAC1/RAC2/RHOH (including NADPH oxidase activation) to dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing, unlike confusables on chemokine-receptor binding, CXCR4 or immunological synapse formation.

qualifier: IL-6, LIF and CNTF via STAT3
name: IL-6, LIF and CNTF gp130 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-6-type cytokine receptor-ligand interactions and IL-6, LIF and CNTF signaling via JAK-STAT3 (with ERK1/2 activation), distinguishing it from confusables on IL-2/IL-7/IL-9 STAT5 signaling, CSF1, IL-27/IL-35 or IL-11.

name: Gonadotropin control of ovulation, luteinization and testis development
rationale: Members link FSH/LH secretion and response to follicle development, ovulation, luteinization and the estrous cycle and to Sertoli, Leydig and germ cell development in the testis, unlike confusables on activin/AMH signaling, antral follicle growth and luteolysis, oocyte maturation or glycoprotein hormone receptors.

qualifier: E3 ligation, atypical and branched chain linkages
name: E3 ubiquitination, atypical chain linkages and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members cover E3-ligase ubiquitination, K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched chain formation, N-end and C-end degron pathways, the proteasome and regulation of proteasomal catabolism, distinguishing it from confusables on deubiquitinases and neddylation, ERAD and misfolded-protein quality control, or ribosome-associated quality control.

qualifier: pregnenolone to progestins, androgens and estrogens
name: Steroidogenesis from pregnenolone to androgens and estrogens
rationale: Members cover steroidogenic P450 reactions (CYP11A1, CYP17A1, CYP19A1, CYP21A2, CYP11B and their ferredoxin electron supply) producing pregnenolone, progesterone, androgens and estrogens, whereas confusables center on glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid biosynthesis and secretion.

qualifier: amino acid and LKB1-AMPK energy sensing
name: Amino acid and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: All four members concern activation of mTORC1 signaling and its control by amino acids and LKB1-AMPK energy status, unlike confusables on amino acid and peptide transporters or mTORC1/p53 metabolic gene programs.

core: Viral genome replication and transcription in the nucleus
name: Influenza vRNA and mRNA synthesis with nuclear vRNP assembly
rationale: Members describe influenza polymerase synthesis of viral mRNA and genomic vRNA and assembly of vRNP complexes in the host nucleus, distinguishing it from confusables on cytoplasmic coronavirus replication and translation or HIV reverse transcription and integration.

name: Autonomic neural crest development and sympathoadrenal catecholamine synthesis
rationale: Members cover endothelin-dependent neural crest migration into enteric, sympathetic and adrenal lineages together with noradrenergic neuron development and catecholamine biosynthesis, whereas confusables emphasize RET/GDNF signaling, gut motility or endothelin blood-pressure control.
